verdict.rationale: A probe found an llms.txt at zoho.com (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at a vendor-published llms.txt. It is a suite-level Zoho file, though, and nothing shows it covers Zoho Invoice specifically. The markdown version of the Invoice API docs returned 404, and every OpenAPI path probed returned 404. Missing for 10: an Invoice-specific llms.txt or evidence that the Zoho file covers Invoice, markdown or agent-oriented Invoice API docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Zoho offers a suite of online productivity and collaboration applications.
